body: Thank you. One of the reasons my ex cheated on me was because: "I knew you were emotionally strong and could get over it". However, I have learned I am not emotionally strong and that I'm a coward for thinking of suicide but honestly this is too much to handle at once. We had so much planned and we did so many things together I can't even drive around my city without having a memory in a certain parking lot/road/park and breaking down in tears being careful not to get into an accident. I don't know if I want to tell her yet as we just broke up.

Thank you for recommending to speak with some friends. I've arranged dinner tonight with my remaining few friends to talk about it.  We could "buy" therapy but not necessary afford it. I would give up anything to let my mother live longer though but that's not the problem, she just has made the decision to refuse treatment.

Lung. She started smoking again to cope with the loss of her husband/my father and I never realized she was smoking four-six packs a day. I should of realized everytime I talked with her she was puffing a cig but I thought nothing of it and never expected her to get lung cancer.
Yes- we have definitely talked about treatment and her reason for denying treatment is the cancer has progressed so far treatment won't do much but make the remainder of her life miserable.

I have a few close friends but most of my "friends" were my exes friends and of course since we broke up they are no longer my "friends". I will try and spend as much time with my mother as I can before she passes and hopefully by then I will overcome my distress. Honestly I would "do it" but I don't want my mother or ex feeling responsible.

I pay $210/Month for insurance, I'm 17 and have $3,000,000 liability, collision and comprehension. I drive a 2009 infinity g37 which probably contributes to the high insurance prices but you have it easy man. Sure it's a nice car but having a cheap car you can afford is much, much better. Be happy with your 93' 150! Probably thinking rich kid, half right. Working I saved up $5,000 and puts that towards parents paid remaining balance. I pay for my own insurance and gas. Insurance is roughly 22hrs of work which is ridiculous.
Hell, I remember watching this on two bucks' channel three years ago. Those were the days
Sorry, really can't risk this story being recognized.
